mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees and overcast at Verona Area High School under a waning gibbous moon.

The 2027 Spring Election cycle has officially begun for all 4 Aldermanic Districts. Candidates should visit the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street to pick up the required packets by January 5, as all forms must be submitted in person.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and a 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360, live music at Paddy Mac's, or music at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue where a driver was arrested for O W I with a minor passenger in the vehicle.
Satisfy your cravings with today's flavor, Snickers Swirl. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit to enjoy this delicious choice.
